annotation.title_clean: PORTARIA DECEA Nº 2.094/DNOR8, DE 18 DE MARÇO DE 2026 – ICA 100-40 Aeronaves Não Tripuladas e o Acesso ao Espaço Aéreo Brasileiro
annotation.title_en: DECEA Ordinance No. 2,094/DNOR8 of 18 March 2026 – ICA 100-40 Unmanned Aircraft and Access to Brazilian Airspace
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministério da Defesa, Comando da Aeronáutica, Departamento de Controle do Espaço Aéreo (DECEA)
annotation.venue: Boletim do Comando da Aeronáutica (BCA nº 058, 30 March 2026)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian DECEA ordinance approving ICA 100-40, which regulates unmanned aircraft access to Brazilian airspace. It sets open, specific and certified operating categories, SARPAS authorization procedures, restricted-zone rules, flight termination and fly-away duties, and enforcement. It bans autonomous UAs, replaces 2023 ordinances, and takes effect 1 July 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: No unmanned aircraft may access Brazilian airspace without State authorization via SARPAS.
Operations are categorised as open, specific or certified by weight (25 kg), VLOS/BVLOS and 400 ft height.
Autonomous UAs are not regulated and not authorized to access Brazilian airspace.
Operators must prepare flight termination plans and report fly-away events immediately.
Revokes DECEA ordinances 928, 929 and 930 of 2023; in force 1 July 2026.
